overall_reason: The system UI stack (Segoe UI drew every glyph at 1440 per fonts.json; system-ui computed at 375) sets every role, which fits a product-UI (Operate) composition on the same 14/12px ladder as the deploy card, but a scale transform doubles the card, so the row title draws 28px tall and the frame cuts off the Deploy button and every timestamp.

score.reason: T-LADDER: the card is enlarged to twice its size, so the 14px row title becomes the largest type in the frame, and the head-to-row step stays at 600 against 500.

findings.title: The scale fits the medium
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json 'Checkout redesign' (14px, 18px line) draws in a 36px-tall box, and 'Recent deploys' (14px, 20px line) in a 40px box: a scale of 2. 'Deploy' sits at x=823, and 'Just now', '12m ago' and '1h ago' sit at x=850 to 871. The frame ends near x=708 on P46/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png, so these labels do not show.
findings.before: Card scaled to 2, so the 14px row title draws at about 28px
findings.after: Show the card at 1:1 so the head, rows, timestamps and button stay in frame, or crop to a region whose type stays at its set size
findings.why: Doubling the card makes body-size UI text act as display type and pushes the status column out of view.

findings.title: Weight steps are clear
findings.where: Card head and row titles, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json the head 'Recent deploys' is 14px/600 and the row titles 'Checkout redesign', 'Search speedup' and 'Pricing copy' are 14px/500. The head and the rows have the same size, and only a 100-weight step separates them. On P46/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png the head reads no stronger than the rows.
findings.after: Separate the head from the rows by size (head 15 to 16px, or rows 13px), or by a clear weight step (400 against 600 or 700)
findings.why: A 500-to-600 step at the same size looks like a rendering difference, so the card has no clear entry point.

strengths: The underlying type is consistent: 14px/500 row titles over 12px/400 meta.
not_investigated: T-MEASURE: no paragraph of 3 or more lines at either width
Size floors under 12px (A11-002) and contrast belong to the sweep and the color lens; not repeated here
The cropped right column (timestamps and the Deploy button) is mainly a framing question for the structure lens
